whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Ridhvi's Restro,

I noticed your restaurant has amazing 4.5★ reviews from 178 happy diners near Atal Path, but lacked a dedicated mobile booking and online menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, online menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/ridhvis

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Ridhvi's Restro, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (Ridhvi's Restro) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with your 4.5-star rating and an online menu showcase for customers near Atal Path and Rajbansi Nagar. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
